boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Otterbein traditions spanning welcome-week rituals, service, campus celebrations, rivalry, and commencement.

cards.title: Painting the Rock
cards.subtitle: Otterbein University, Westerville
cards.notes: Plan a design with your organization, then use the campus sign-up process to add your message to this recurring Otterbein tradition.
cards.short_summary: Campus groups use the Rock as a changing public canvas.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s OtterBinder identifies Painting the Rock as an Otterbein tradition.
cards.access_notes: Follow the university’s sign-up guidance before painting.

cards.title: The Schneider’s Doughnut Run
cards.subtitle: Otterbein University to Uptown Westerville
cards.notes: Join the annual doughnut run with friends and confirm the current route and timing through campus programming before heading uptown.
cards.short_summary: A named bakery run links campus to Uptown Westerville.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s OtterBinder lists the doughnut run to Schneider’s Bakery in Uptown Westerville as a tradition.
cards.access_notes: Confirm event logistics and bakery availability before participating.

cards.title: Tree Lighting and Holiday Feast

cards.title: First Flight
cards.subtitle: Otterbein University, Westerville

cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s OtterBinder identifies First Flight as an Otterbein tradition.

cards.title: New Student Welcome Convocation

cards.short_summary: A formal welcome gathering that marks the beginning of an Otterbein career.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s OtterBinder lists New Student Welcome Convocation among its traditions.

cards.title: Faculty Clap-Out at Commencement
cards.subtitle: Otterbein University, Westerville
cards.notes: At commencement, notice the faculty clap-out and follow the ceremony’s instructions so graduates and guests can take part respectfully.
cards.short_summary: Faculty applause forms a distinctive part of Otterbein’s commencement ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s OtterBinder lists the faculty clap-out at Commencement as a tradition.
cards.access_notes: Occurs as part of commencement; attendance follows current ceremony policies.

cards.title: Community Service Plunge Days
cards.subtitle: Otterbein University and community sites
cards.notes: Choose a listed service assignment when Plunge Days are announced, and prepare for the site-specific work and transportation instructions.
cards.short_summary: A campus-wide service tradition that also includes alumni participation.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s OtterBinder describes Community Service Plunge Days as a tradition involving the campus and alumni.
cards.access_notes: Registration, assignments, and requirements vary by year.

cards.title: Homecoming Parade
cards.subtitle: Otterbein University, Westerville
cards.notes: Check the Homecoming schedule, pick a campus viewing point, and use the official route and event guidance for the annual parade.
cards.short_summary: An annual Homecoming parade gives the broader Cardinal community a shared campus moment.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s OtterBinder lists Homecoming events and parade as Otterbein traditions.
cards.access_notes: Annual event; route, access, and schedule are set in current Homecoming materials.

cards.title: Late Night Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Otterbein University, Westerville
cards.notes: Look for the term’s event announcement, confirm the dining location and access rules, then make it part of your end-of-term routine.
cards.short_summary: A recurring late-evening breakfast event held each term.
cards.evidence_claim: Otterbein’s OtterBinder lists Late Night Breakfast each term as a tradition.
cards.access_notes: The source confirms it occurs each term but does not provide current late hours; verify timing with Dining or campus events.
